rationale: The papers 'A population analysis of pulse broadening in ASKAP Fast Radio Bursts' (2006.16502) and 'Intrinsic Pulse Widths of FRB 20121102A and Calculation of Broadening from Propagation and Instrumental Effects' (2402.02360) provide evidence related to pulse broadening, contributing to the understanding of the variability and potential causes of the observed effects.
